Wide horizontal composition, aspect ratio 16:9, main subject well inside the central area with generous margins on every side, so the image can be cropped, quiet uncluttered area in the upper half for a title. Photorealistic editorial still life for a high-end craft workshop, warm, playful and precise mood, palette of cream pattern paper, light kraft brown, tailor's chalk blue and a single accent of bright thread red, soft morning daylight from a tall window on the left, tactile pattern paper, raw linen, printed cotton, wooden spools and steel pins, set in a small sewing studio in a lakeside town of western Switzerland on a bright autumn morning, soft raking light that reveals the texture of the material, gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, calm and tactile, modern minimal composition with generous negative space. No finished piece, no artwork, no product presented as the craftsman's own work, no branded machine, no tattoo designs, no people's faces. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no signage, no watermark, no signature, no recognizable person, no visible face, no real or famous people, not a specific real building or landmark.
